title: DNA Quantification
learningObjectives: Calculate DNA concentration and yield from A260.
Read A260/A280 and A260/A230 as purity checks.
Predict what a ratio outside the usual range suggests, and what it cannot tell you.
plannedActivities: Predict the verdict for each sample card, then read its ratios
Calculate the concentration and yield of your DNA
assessmentObjectives: Your DNA reads A260 = 0.75 (10 mm path). What is its concentration?
A sample’s A260/A280 is 1.60. What is the most likely explanation?

title: PCR Amplification
learningObjectives: Explain why each PCR cycle roughly doubles the target.
Predict how primer orientation, annealing temperature, polymerase and cycle number change the product.
Convert template mass into a starting copy number.
plannedActivities: Set up the thermocycler and predict the product
Follow the copy count cycle by cycle
assessmentObjectives: Starting from about 1,100 template copies, roughly how many copies do 10 ideal cycles give?
Why does the target roughly double every cycle?

title: Gel Electrophoresis
learningObjectives: Explain why DNA moves through an agarose gel and which way it goes.
Estimate a fragment’s size against a ladder using a log scale.
Predict the effect of reversed electrodes, an early stop or ethanol in the sample.
plannedActivities: Run the PCR product beside a ladder
Estimate the band size on a log scale
assessmentObjectives: The band sits between the 800 and 900 bp ladder bands, about halfway on the log scale. What is the best estimate?
Which way do DNA fragments move in the gel?

title: Restriction Digest
learningObjectives: Predict fragment sizes from known restriction sites.
Count fragments for linear and circular DNA.
Recognize an incomplete digest on a gel.
plannedActivities: Choose enzymes and predict the fragments
Check the prediction on a gel beside the uncut product
assessmentObjectives: EcoRI cuts the 850 bp product once, 300 bp from one end. Which bands do you expect?
A linear DNA has two sites for an enzyme. How many fragments does a complete digest give?
